en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the high altar inside a small church. The central image is a richly decorated baroque altar with columns and statues, dominated by a statue of a bishop saint holding a crozier, with smaller religious figures below. The photograph occupies the left and central parts, while the right margin has printed German caption text bordered by dotted lines, leaving space for writing.
